mapper.select: select p.id, p.provider_code as providerCode, p.provider_name as providerName, p.base_url as baseUrl, p.provider_type as providerType, p.status, p.priority_no as priorityNo, p.timeout_ms as timeoutMs, p.created_at as createdAt, ( select count(*) from provider_tokens t where t.provider_id = p.id and t.deleted = 0 ) as tokenCount from providers p where p.deleted = 0 order by p.priority_no asc, p.id desc
